// Historical diagnostic reproducer for baseline 05528a92e / 0a140df7f only.
// Use that baseline with go test -overlay; this predates the checked reader API.
// Current passing regressions are TestCLIInventoryChannelIntegrity and
// TestCLIInventoryPresence in internal/runtime/llm/cli_inventory_test.go.
package llm

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	runtimeactors "github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/actors"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/managedcapabilities"
	"github.com/division-sh/swarm/internal/runtime/core/toolcapabilities"
)

func TestCommandLiveMCPOnlyCapabilityProbe(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name            string
		native          bool
		advertiseNative bool
		wantValid       bool
	}{
		{"mcp_only", false, false, true},
		{"mcp_and_native", true, true, true},
		{"unexpected_native", false, true, false},
		{"missing_native", true, false, false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			actor := runtimeactors.AgentConfig{ID: "census-agent", NativeTools: runtimeactors.NativeToolConfig{Bash: test.native}}
			actor.Identity = testAgentIdentity(actor.ID, "")
			var definitions []ToolDefinition
			var capabilities []toolcapabilities.Capability
			tools := []string{"ExitPlanMode"}
			for _, name := range []string{"read_chat", "emit_telegram_reply_requested"} {
				definitions = append(definitions, ToolDefinition{Name: name, Schema: map[string]any{"type": "object"}})
				capabilities = append(capabilities, toolcapabilities.Capability{Name: name, Kind: toolcapabilities.KindStandard, Visible: true, Callable: true})
				tools = append(tools, "mcp__runtime-tools__"+name)
			}
			if test.advertiseNative {
				tools = append(tools, "Bash")
			}
			surface, err := managedCapabilityPlanForTest(runtimeactors.WithActor(context.Background(), actor), &ClaudeCLIRuntime{}, "", definitions, toolcapabilities.NewSet(capabilities), nativeCapabilityTestAuthority())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			init, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "tools": tools, "mcp_servers": []map[string]string{{"name": "runtime-tools", "status": "connected"}}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			acc := newCLIStreamAccumulator()
			acc.AddLine(init)
			response := acc.Response()
			observed, err := ObserveCLIResponseCapabilitySurface(surface, response)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			err = ValidateCLIProviderCapabilitySurface(observed, response)
			t.Logf("provider=%v canonical=%v planned=%v interpreted=%v mismatches=%v error=%v", response.ProviderVisibleTools, response.VisibleTools, surface.PlannedBindingNames(managedcapabilities.BindingProviderBuiltin), exactCLIProviderVisibleTools(response), observed.HasMismatch(), err)
			if (err == nil) != test.wantValid {
				t.Fatalf("valid=%t, want %t", err == nil, test.wantValid)
			}
		})
	}
}
